name: Withdrawal
prompt: A man two days into withdrawal is pulling at his IV and shouting that he's leaving. He swings when you reach for the line.

outcome.told: Security holds the door while the doctor orders something to settle him. He sleeps by the end of the hour.
You keep your voice low and your hands where he can see them. He sits back down on the bed.

failure.told: His fist catches you across the jaw. You're sent home and the hospital files a report with the police.
